note: Generated by art/slice_views.py from art/source/views/*.webp. Paths are relative to this file. Views: front, left (figure faces viewer-left), right (faces viewer-right), back - same column order and facing as art/source/base-*-turnaround.webp. Each view's source.box is [x, y, w, h] in sheet px (sprite px = sheet px, including the 2px padding); all four views of an item come from one sheet row at one drawing scale, so box offsets between views give their relative size and vertical alignment. scaleRef restates this per item: rowTop/rowBottom = union of the four boxes, and per view dy = box top - rowTop, bottomGap = rowBottom - box bottom, heightVsFront = h / front h. parts: offset = position of the part inside the view's sprite; source.column = 0-based sheet column (long-waves has its side columns swapped on the sheet, so its left view comes from column 2); a box may extend a few px past the sheet edge (transparent padding); left/right = viewer's left/right. faceHole (hair front only) as in ../manifest.json.
